title: struts colour config
description: Palette colours, role aliases and schemes for postcss/color-system.js.

colors.description: Keyed by kebab-case name. Each becomes --color-{name}, surface-{name} and on-{name}.

dark.description: Role → colour name or CSS value. Keys must be aliases, or an alias + "-foreground". Output under prefers-color-scheme: dark and [data-scheme=dark].

value.description: A colour name from this config (becomes var(--color-{name})) or any CSS value.

color.description: Any CSS colour culori can parse (hex, rgb(), oklch() …).

name.description: Human label, for editors and adapters.

foreground.description: Text colour on this colour. Becomes --color-{name}-foreground.

colorScheme.description: Overrides the color-scheme worked out from luminance.

vars.description: Custom properties set by surface-{name} and on-{name}. Set role tokens (--color-accent …), not component variables.

meta.description: Free-form data for adapters and tooling, e.g. { "wordpress": { "editor": true } } to list the colour in the block editor palette. The plugin ignores it.

alias.description: Another colour's name. Emitted as var(--color-{alias}).
